1. **`S107-SDW-2ND-MOMENT-EFT`** (EVOI §3 Tier-3 #12; register-sourced). Extend the SDW (Seeley-DeWitt) layer-expansion EFT-control diagnostic from the **established base/successive-moment layer** (the S96-SDW-EFT-CONTROL INFO at the `<0.5` band) to the **2nd SDW layer**, evaluated at the species scale Λ_sp where the EFT is supposed to be controlled, against the **tighter `< 0.1` EFT-control ceiling**. This is a GEOMETRIC spectral-functional convergence diagnostic. **Owner/executor**: lizzi-spectral-functional-theorist.

2. **`S107-W1-RTREND-L1416`** (S106 W1 commensurability workshop CF; **OPTIONAL / NON-BLOCKING**). **Carry-forward source**: Stream 2 register-sourced (EVOI Tier-3 #12) for item 1; Stream 1 WP/workshop CF (`s106-w1-commensurability-reconciliation.md:609`, CF-S107-W1-RTREND-L1416) for item 2.

```yaml
    Step 2 -- Substitution (no simplification):
      The 2nd-layer EFT-control ratio (scheme-independent a-ratio driver, f-ratio = 1):
        r_2nd = (a_8 / a_6) * (Lambda_sp/M_KK)^{-2}
```

## §W3-2. S107-W1-RTREND-L1416  —  OPTIONAL / NON-BLOCKING

> **OPTIONAL / NON-BLOCKING precision-tightening item.** #9e-B (length-spectrum incommensurate-Poisson) is **CLOSED at L12** (S106-W1-SFF-UNFOLDING-L12 PASS, ⟨r⟩=0.4118; three-method robustness + the asymptotic Loeschian-quadratic-Poisson theorem). This gate CANNOT change the SPLIT verdict or reopen #9e-B regardless of outcome. It converts the L12-only Poisson value into a measured truncation trend across L∈{12,14,16}. If wave capacity is constrained, this gate drops first.

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "S107-W1-RTREND-L1416"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"        # reproduction/trend-confirmation of an already-CLOSED result at higher truncation; not a new directional claim
classification: "GEOMETRIC" # level statistics of the D_K spectrum at the fixed tau_fold slice (the fabric's spectral fluctuation structure, Level-1)
agent_type: "spectral-geometer"
hypothesis: >
  The degeneracy-resolved unfolding <r> evaluated on the L14 and L16 degeneracy-resolved spectra
  (S106 caches) each land in the Poisson-incommensurate band [0.37, 0.44], confirming no truncation
  drift off the L12 value <r>=0.4118 (flat-Poisson trend across L in {12,14,16}; the #9e-B
  incommensurate-Poisson SPLIT half is asymptotically stable, not an L12 artifact).

method:
  description: >
    Recompute the consecutive-spacing ratio <r> on the L14 and L16 degeneracy-resolved spectra
    via the EXACT S106-W1-SFF-UNFOLDING-L12 pipeline (SPEC-B global degeneracy-merge), then place
    each L-point in the Poisson-incommensurate band. The SPEC-B pipeline (validated S46 source
    s46_spectral_form_factor.py, reproduced at S106 W1-2): (i) form the global unique D_K^2 spectrum
    E_unique = unique(round-10 of |lambda|^2) collapsing exact Peter-Weyl + Fegan within-sector
    degeneracies (merge_tol = exact-degeneracy round-10, NOT a finite tol -- the abs_evals carry
    bit-exact degeneracies); (ii) fit a smooth polynomial staircase, best of degrees 3-7 by
    max-residual; (iii) unfold; (iv) compute <r> = mean of consecutive-spacing ratios
    min(s_i,s_{i+1})/max(s_i,s_{i+1}). Pre-register the unfolding spec per the S106 1b convention:
      poly_deg = best-of {3,4,5,6,7} by max-residual (SPEC-B primary);
      sigma-insensitive Weyl-smooth cross-check (the second method that landed 0.3888 ~ 2ln2-1 =
        0.38629 EXACT at L12) reported as the FI cross-check;

    GOE value 0.5307 above; the band is the S106-W1-SFF-UNFOLDING-L12 pre-registered Track-B
    band, reachable analytically at the asymptotic Loeschian-quadratic Poisson limit (the

    sub-Poisson 0.27). The L12 datum 0.4118 (SPEC-B) is already in-band.

  N_eval: "2"                 # 2 new L-points (L14, L16_operational); L12 is the already-landed baseline reproduced as anchor
  L_max: "16"                 # nominal top truncation; L16 is OPERATIONALLY 15 (incomplete top shell -- see L16-incompleteness pin)

  tolerance: "1e-10"          # round-10 exact-degeneracy merge tolerance for unique(|lambda|^2) (SPEC-B canonical merge)
  scheme: "S46-DEGENERACY-RESOLVED-UNFOLDING"
  convention: "SPEC-B-global-degeneracy-merge"   # PRIMARY; SPEC-A per-sector + sigma-insensitive Weyl-smooth are cross-reads
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8"   # the spectra are PRE-BUILT in the S106 cache; only the unfold + <r> arithmetic on ~7000-9000 unique levels is new (no diagonalization -- the cache holds abs_evals); CPU-capped
  # additional fixed pins enumerated for the producing script (PRDR dry-run):

  poly_deg_select: "best-of-by-max-residual"   # the degree-selection rule (matches S106-W1-SFF-UNFOLDING-L12)

  clustered_ref: "0.27"      # commensurate-clustered <r> reference (FAIL-toward-commensurate sentinel; would reopen #9e-B)
  poisson_asymptote: "0.38629"   # 2*ln(2)-1 EXACT (Atas et al. Poisson <r>); the sigma-insensitive Weyl-smooth landed here at L12
  L16_operational: "15"      # the actual dense top shell present in sector_evals_L16 (cache: L16_operational=15, L16_full=False)
  L16_fb_tail: "FB-bounded-analytic-only"   # the 17 missing top sectors are FB-bounded (eta_FB_lower=0.3928), NOT diagonalized; disclosed in verdict + WP
  PUB_PRECISION: "4"         # publication precision of the <r> trend values

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true             # the gate makes a band-membership directional claim (no L-drift toward GOE/clustered)
  content: |
    Claim: "<r>(L14) and <r>(L16_operational) each land in [0.37, 0.44], confirming no truncation
            drift off the L12 value 0.4118 (flat-Poisson trend; not drifting toward GOE 0.5307 or
            clustered 0.27)."

    Step 1 -- Definitions (cite source):
      <r>(L) = mean over the unfolded L-spectrum of min(s_i, s_{i+1})/max(s_i, s_{i+1}),
        s_i = consecutive spacing of the unfolded global-unique D_K^2 spectrum at truncation L
        (SPEC-B; S106-W1-SFF-UNFOLDING-L12 pipeline; S46 source).
      Poisson asymptote = 2*ln(2) - 1 = 0.38629 (Atas-Bogomolny-Giraud-Roux).
      GOE = 0.5307; clustered (commensurate) = 0.27.
      L12 baseline (already landed): <r>_SPEC-B = 0.4118; sigma-insensitive Weyl-smooth = 0.3888
        (~ 0.38629 EXACT); SPEC-A = 0.4527.

    Step 2 -- Substitution (no simplification):
      Build E_unique(L) = unique(round-10 of |lambda(L)|^2) from sector_evals_L{14,16} (S106 cache);
      fit poly-staircase deg = best-of {3..7} by max-residual; unfold; compute <r>(L14), <r>(L16_op).

    Step 3 -- Simplification (trend read):
      Place <r>(L14), <r>(L16_op) on the L-grid {12, 14, 16} alongside the L12 anchor 0.4118.
      The substrate is an asymptotically-Poisson degree-2 Loeschian form (Berry-Tabor, [iK_7,D_K]=0
      integrable, lambda_L=0): higher L INCREASES the level count (N_unique grows: L12 already has
      ~7002) and the <r> statistic CONVERGES toward the Poisson asymptote 0.38629 from the
      finite-size value. So <r>(L) is expected to stay in [0.37, 0.44] and not drift up toward GOE.

    Step 4 -- Read off the DIRECTION:
      Expected: <r>(L14), <r>(L16_op) in [0.37, 0.44], flat-to-slightly-decreasing-toward-0.38629
      (Poisson convergence), NOT increasing toward GOE 0.5307 nor collapsing toward clustered 0.27.
      sign_verdict (for the [VERIFY] trend): PASS iff both new points are in-band (no drift off Poisson).
      NOTE: this CANNOT reopen #9e-B (CLOSED at L12); a hypothetical out-of-band point would be a
      precision-diagnostic INFO/FAIL on the TREND, not a reopening of the SPLIT verdict.
```
